market.title: EU Instant Payments Regulation First Reporting Deadline Hits April 9 with One-Third of PSPs Ready
market.summary: Payment service providers in the EU face their first reporting deadline on April 9, 2026, under the Instant Payments Regulation. thought.title: 2025 Global Treasury Survey
thought.summary: This comprehensive survey by PwC, drawing insights from 350 treasurers worldwide, details how treasury functions are navigating an increasingly complex global environment. The report emphasizes a shift towards more connected operating models, prioritizing enhanced cash visibility, cost efficiency, and robust risk management through deeper integration with business units. Key findings include the growing adoption of advanced technologies such as in-house banks, real-time liquidity tools, and AI-enhanced forecasting to optimize working capital and unlock trapped cash. The study concludes that treasury's role is transforming from a transactional function to a strategic, data-driven partner, crucial for enterprise value creation, with a heightened focus on cybersecurity and integrated risk frameworks.

thought.title: 2026 Banking and Capital Markets Outlook
thought.summary: Deloitte's 2026 Banking and Capital Markets Outlook forecasts a pivotal year for the banking industry, marked by persistent macroeconomic uncertainty, varied consumer sentiment, and ongoing inflation, which are expected to challenge bank revenues and profitability. Despite banks entering 2026 with strong capital positions, they anticipate headwinds in net interest income due to projected lower interest rates and a slowing economy. The report highlights the increasing significance of stablecoins, driven by new regulatory frameworks such as the Genius Act, which could introduce deposit disruption but also present novel business opportunities for financial institutions. A key takeaway is the imperative for banks to transition from fragmented, tactical AI implementations to a strategic, enterprise-wide AI transformation, underpinned by clear vision and robust governance.
thought.implications: CMIplus must closely monitor the evolving landscape of stablecoins and other digital currencies, assessing potential integration or support within its platform to capitalize on emerging payment rails. The report's emphasis on strategic AI adoption suggests CMIplus should explore how AI can enhance its platform's capabilities, particularly in areas like fraud prevention, advanced data analytics, and automated treasury processes. Understanding the broader macroeconomic headwinds and the intensifying competition from nonbank entities will be critical for CMIplus to refine its competitive positioning and value proposition for corporate clients.
